brands.evidence: I’d pick Monzo instead if you regularly split expenses with other people or want to organise your salary
I’d pick Starling as the better all-round free UK current account.

client_claims.text: Monzo’s virtual cards start with Extra at £3/month.
client_claims.note: Extra is £3 a month; virtual card availability is not covered, but the price matches.

client_claims.text: Monzo Free charges 3% after £200 in any 30 days outside the UK and European Economic Area.
client_claims.note: Matches the £200 allowance outside the EEA and 3% fee; the answer says 'UK and EEA' which is a minor variation.

client_claims.text: Neither bank charges for overseas card purchases.
client_claims.note: Monzo charges no fee on card spending abroad.

client_claims.text: Monzo’s Salary Sorter can automatically divide your pay into Pots for rent, bills and spending.
Monzo Split tracks ongoing shared costs, and friends can join by link without opening a Monzo account.
Monzo charges £1 per deposit at a Post Office or PayPoint.
client_claims.note: Cash deposit fees are not in the facts.

client_claims.text: If your employer pays by Bacs, Monzo lets you access your salary one business day early.
client_claims.note: Early salary access is not in the facts.
